# Posting a life entry from your phone

Every entry starts as a GitHub issue. The site formats and publishes it
for you.

1. Open the GitHub app and go to katsuma0.github.io.
2. New issue.
3. Title: the entry title, then a pipe and the place.
   Example: `canoe weekend | Grundy Lake, Ontario`
   The place is optional.
4. Body: write the text. Blank lines make paragraphs.
   The date comes from the day you post. To use a different month, put
   a line like `date: july 2026` anywhere in the body.
5. Attach the photos with the camera button. Multiples of three fill
   the grid in full rows; other counts still work.
6. Add the `life` label and submit.

Within about a minute the workflow downloads the photos, resizes them
to webp with thumbnails, adds the entry to the top of life.html,
commits, comments on the issue with the link, and closes it. Only
issues opened by the repository owner are processed.
